fusions.name: Sprung From Still Water
fusions.desc: You spring a venom-laced bolt that deals 14 water damage, knocks the target back 2.5 tiles and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Slick Skin Spray
fusions.desc: Sprays toxic slime across the 2.5 tiles ahead of you, dealing 4 poison damage to everything in the cone, with a 40% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Toxic Skin
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are left [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Long Crouch
fusions.desc: When your stamina is full, your next ability deals 30% more damage. Once every 10 seconds.
